content:
The amount after \(n\) years is

\[
\frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\]

million rubles. We need this to be a three-digit number with identical digits.

Checking those numbers, \(666\) works:

\[
\frac{n(n+1)}{2}=666
\]

\[
n(n+1)=1332
\]

\[
n^2+n-1332=0
\]

\[
n=\frac{-1+\sqrt{1+5328}}{2}=\frac{-1+73}{2}=36
\]

So the great-grandson will be \(36\) years old.

\[
\boxed{36}
\]
